sa: ततः क्रुद्धो रणे पार्थः शरान् संधाय कार्मुके॥ प्रेषयामास समरे स्वर्णपुडाञ्छिलाशितान्।
en: Thereupon, wrought up with rage Partha fixing on his bow-string arrows full finished with gold wings and whetted on stone, discharged them at your son.

sa: जेतव्यमिति चान्योन्यं येषां नित्यं दि स्थितम्। अथ चेमे हताः प्राज्ञाः शेरते विगतायुषः॥
en: Alas even those who entertained in their heart the hopes of conquering one another in battle, are now lying slain deprived of their senses, in spite of all their wisdom.

sa: श्रद्दधानो हि तद्वाक्यं देवस्याच्युततेजसः। छादयामास तां कन्यां पुमानिति च सोऽब्रवीत्॥
en: Reverencing the words of that god of immeasurable glory, he kept to himself that she was a daughter, and said, “This is a male child."

sa: यद् द्रौणिसायकान् घोरान् प्रत्यवारयतां युधि॥ सहदेवं तथा यान्तं कृपः शारद्वतोऽभ्ययात्।
en: In as much as they repulsed all the dreadful arrows shot by Drona's son. Then Kripa the son of Sharadvata rushed against the advancing Sahadeva,

sa: तं स्वर्गमेघ गतः शूरो यो हतो न पराङ्मुखः। संस्तम्भयत मा भैष्ट विजेष्यामो रणे रिपून्।॥
en: This heroic son of Subhadra who without turning back from the battle has been slain by the enemy, has ascended to heaven. Stay you all and do not fear. We shall yet conquer the foe.

sa: नोपशाम्यति निर्घोषो धनुषां कूजतां तथा। विनिश्चेरुः शरा दीप्ता ज्योतीषीव नभस्तलात्॥
en: The twang of the bows did not stop for a movement and the blazing arrows flashed through the air like meteor falling from the sky.

sa: ततो दाशार्णको राजा तीव्रकोपसमन्वितः। दूतं प्रस्थापयामास दुपदस्य निवेशनम्॥
en: Thereupon the king of Dasharna country, being filled with terrible anger, sent an ambassador to the court of king Drupada.

sa: तस्मिन् विनिहते वीरे बह्वशोभत मेदिनी। द्यौर्यथा पूर्णचन्द्रेण नक्षत्रगणमालिनी॥
en: When that hero had been slaughtered, the earth appeared highly beautiful like the starry firmament decked with the full-moon herself.

sa: दैवं हि मानुषोपेतं भृशं सिद्ध्यति पार्थिव। परस्परविरोधाद्धि सिद्धिरस्ति न चैतयोः॥
en: When earthy power is joined to godly power, it will surely succeed, O king. But there is no success when these are against each other,

sa: एष संदृश्यते पार्थो वासुदेवव्यपाश्रयः। दारयन् सर्वसैन्यानि धार्तराष्ट्राणि सर्वशः॥
en: Yonder is seen the son of Pritha having Vasudeva for his protector, and checking all the troops of Dhritarashtra's host.

sa: अवादयन् दुन्दुभीश्च शतशश्चैव पुष्करान्। सिंहनादांश्च विविधान् विनेदुः पुरुषर्षभाः॥
en: They ordered thousands of drums and cymbals to be played. Those foremost of men themselves also sent up lion-like roars.

sa: तेजस्विनः : कुमारस्य शराः परमदारुणाः॥ क्षिण्वन्ति हृदयं मेऽद्य घोराः पावकतेजसः। तमाचार्योऽब्रवीत् कर्णं शनकैः प्रहसन्निव॥
en: The fierce and exceedingly dreadful darts, corroding like fire, of this very furious prince, are this day sucking my heart's strength in battle.” Then softly and with a smile the preceptor replied to Karna saying-

sa: प्रतियाते दशार्णे तु पार्थिवे हेमवर्मणि। कन्यैव हि भविष्यामि पुरुषस्त्वं भविष्यसि॥
en: On the departure of the Dashara king, who is known as the golden-armoured heroes, I will become a woman, and you will become a man.

sa: शतघ्नीं च कृपो राजञ्छरं शल्यश्च संयुगे॥ अथेतरे महेष्वासाः पञ्च शिलीमुखान्। भीमसेनं समुद्दिश्य प्रेषयामासुरोजसा॥ तोमरं च द्विधा चक्रे क्षुरप्रेणानिलात्मजः।
en: Kripa hurled at Bhima a Shataghni, and O king, Shalya a fierce dare; of the other warriors cach, aiming at Bhima, forcibly let go five shafts whetted on stone. Then the son of the wind-god (Bhima), with a horse-shoe-headed arrow, cut that lance in twain.

sa: यन्मे कन्यां स्वकन्यार्थं वृतवानसि दुर्मते। फलं तस्यावलेपस्य द्रक्ष्यस्यद्य न संशयः॥
en: That as you selected my daughter for your daughter, O wicked one, so you will see the fruit of that insult very soon, no doubt,

sa: ततो वृन्दारकं वीरं कुरूणां कीर्तिवर्धनम्। पुत्राणां तव वीराणां पश्यतामवधीद् बली॥
en: Thereafter the valiant Abhimanyu slew the warlike Vrindaraka the enhancer of the glory of the Kurus, even before the very eyes of your heroic son.

sa: रथाश्च बहवो भग्ना हयाच शतशो हताः। गजाश्च सगजारोहा: पेतुरु। महाहवे॥
en: Many cars were shattered; and steeds by hundreds were slain and in that fierce conflict, elephants with their riders fell on the ground by hundreds.

sa: कृतवर्मा च हार्दिक्य: षड् रथाः पर्यवारयन्। तांस्तु विद्ध्वा शितैर्बाणैर्विमुखीकृत्य चार्जुनिः॥
en: Kritavarman the son of Hridika, these six warriors surrounded Subhadra's son. But the son of Arjuna piercing them with whetted shafts and bcating them back.

sa: लक्ष्मणं निहतं दृष्ट्वा हाहेत्युच्चुक्रुशुर्जनाः। ततो दुर्योधनः क्रुद्धः प्रिये पुत्रे निपातिते॥
en: Bcholding Lakshmana slain, people began to wail aloud saying 'Oh' and 'Alas.' Thereupon at the death of his dear-loved son, Duryodhana became inflamed with rage.

sa: धृष्टद्युम्नस्तु राजेन्द्र सर्वसैन्यान्यचोदयत्। अभ्यद्रवत गाङ्गेयं मा भैष्टं रथसत्तमाः॥
en: Then, 0 foremost of kings, Dhrishtadyumna urged on the troops to assail Ganga's son exclaiming, “Fear not, O excelient car-warriors.”

sa: लाज्यैश्च गन्धैश्च तथा वितानैरभ्यर्चितं धूपनधूपितं च। ध्वजैः पताकाभिरलंकृतं च भक्ष्यानपेयामिषदन्तहोमम्॥
en: And with fragrant roots (of plants) and scented with the smoke of sweet incense, and ornamented with banners and well supplied with food and drink.

sa: दशाहानि ततस्तप्त्वा भीष्मः पाण्डववाहिनीम्। निरविद्यत धर्मात्मा जीवितेन परंतप॥
en: Having consumed the Pandava ranks for ten days, the high-souled Bhishma, O afflicter of foes, became disregardful of his life.

sa: संजय उवाच अभिमन्युर्महाराज तव पुत्रमयोधयत्। महत्या सेनया युक्तं भीष्महेतोः पराक्रमी॥
en: Sanjaya said Then for the sake of Bhishma's slaughter, the highly powerful Abhimanyu, o mighty monarch, engaged with your son supported by his large division.

sa: द्रोण उवाच न शत्रु तात पश्यामि यो मां हन्याद् रथे स्थितम्। युध्यमानं सुसंरब्धं शरवर्षांघवर्षिणम्॥
en: arms Drona said O son, I cannot see such an antagonist who may kill me when I stand in battle, when I fight with my anger excited and when I scatter incessantly shower of arrows.

sa: मण्डलानि विचित्राणि गतप्रत्यागतानि च। चेरतुर्दर्शयन्तौ च प्रार्थयन्तौ परस्परम्॥
en: Longing to get near each other, they wheeled and inoved, displaying various charming circles and various forward and backward movements.

sa: गिरिमात्रा हि ते नागा भिन्नाञ्जनचयोपमाः। विरेजुर्वसुधां प्राप्ता विकीर्णा इव पर्वताः॥
en: Those elephants prodigious like hills and resembling broken heaps of antimony appeared beautiful, as they lay prostrate, like so many mountains covering the earth's surface.

sa: योधानां दशसाहस्रं कृत्वा भागं महाद्युते। सहस्रं रथिनामेकमेष भागो मतो मम॥
en: Ten thousand soldiers, by this division, O you of great effulgence, and of car-warriors, one thousand, this I think (I can take as) my share.

sa: तथैव पाण्डवा राजन् सैन्येन महता वृताः। भीष्मं संछादयामासुर्मेघा इव दिवाकरम्॥
en: On the other hand, O king, the sons of Pandu, supported by mighty divisions covered Bhishma over, like clouds covering the orb of the day.

sa: ततः पुरननीकानि न्ययोजयत बुद्धिमान्। मोहयन् धृतराष्ट्रस्य पुत्राणां बुद्धिनिश्चयम्॥
en: Then the intelligent (Yudhishthira) again arranged his troops (in a different order), confounding the knowledge of the sons of Dhritarashtra.

sa: अथ चैते सुसंरब्धाः सिंहा इव बलोत्कटाः॥ सौभद्रमुद्यतास्त्रातुमभ्यधावन्त पाण्डवाः।
en: Yonder rushes the infuriate Pandavas, looking like so many mighty lions, with weapons uplifted, to the rescue of Subhadra's son.

sa: तेषां विंशतिसाहस्रा हयाः शूरैरधिष्ठिताः। पञ्च नागसहस्राणि स्थवंशाच सर्वशः॥
en: Amongst them were twenty thousand horses ridden by brave warriors, and five thousand elephants and cars on all sides round.

sa: शक्ति जग्राह तरसा गिरीणामपि दारणीम्॥ तां च चिक्षेप संक्रुद्धः फाल्गुनस्य रथं प्रति।
en: Bhishma took up a lance with lightness, that was capable of rending even the breasts of mountains, and inflamed with rage he hurled that lance at the car of Phaiguna.

sa: ऋषयो वसवश्चैव वियत्स्था भीष्ममब्रुवन्॥ यत् ते व्यवसितं तात तदस्माकमपि प्रियम्।
en: The Rishis and Vasus stationed in the firmament then thus addressed Bhishma saying "What you have resolved upon O sire, is also our dear will.

sa: ततः किरीटी संक्रुद्धो भीष्ममेवाभ्यवर्तत॥ शिखण्डिनं पुरस्कृत्य धनुश्चास्य समाच्छिनत्।
en: Thereupon inflamed with wrath the diademdecked Arjuna placing Shikhandin before him rushed at Bhishma and cut off the latter's bow.

sa: शरैरनेकसाहौर्मामेवाभ्यहनन् रणे॥ ३. न चैष समरे शक्यो जेतुं बज्रभृता अपि।
en: Is afflicting me in battle with many thousands of arrows. This one is incapable of being conquered even by the wielder of the thunder bolt.

sa: संजय उवाच ततो धनंजयं दृष्ट्वा बाणगाण्डीवधारिणम्। पुनरेव महानादं व्यसृजन्त महारथाः॥
en: Sanjaya said Seeing Dhananjaya (Arjuna) take up once again his Gandiva and arrows, the great carwarriors (of the Pandava army) sent up a tremendous shout.

sa: नारायणं नमस्कृत्य नरं चैव नरोत्तमम्। देवी सरस्वतीं चैव ततो जयमुदीरयेत्।।
en: Having saluted the Supreme Deity (Narayana), and the highest of all male beings (Nara) and also the goddess of Learning (Sarasvati), let us cry success!

sa: यदादित्यगतं तेजो जगद् भासयतेऽखिलम्। यच्चन्द्रमसि यच्चागग्नौ तत् तेजो विद्धि मामकम्॥
en: The refulgence in the Sun which illuminates the vast universe, that which is in the Moon, and in the Fire, know it to be mine.

sa: सौवीराः कितवाः प्राच्याः प्रतीच्योदीच्यमालवाः॥ अभीषाहाः शूरसेनाः शिवयोऽथ वसातयः।
en: Then the Souviras, the Kitavas, the Westerners, the Northermers and the Malavas, the Abhishahas, the Shurasenas, the Shinis, the Vasatis,

sa: तेषां युधिष्ठिरो राजा सर्वेषां पुरुषर्षभ। व्यादिदेश सबाह्यानां भक्ष्यभोज्यमनुत्तमम्॥
en: That foremost of men, king Yudhishthira ordered to be supplied to them in excellent edibles and other things of enjoyment.

sa: एवं कुरूणां पतिते शृङ्गे भीष्मे महौजसि॥ पाण्डवाः सुंजयाश्चैव सिंहनादं प्रचक्रिरे।
en: Thus when the crest of the Kurus, viz., the highly puissant Bhishma was over thrown the Pandavas and the Srinjayas set up a loud warcry.

sa: निविश्य च महात्मानस्ततस्ते पुरुषर्षभाः। हृष्टरूपाः सुमनसो बभूवुः सहसैनिकाः॥
en: Having thus placed their troops those foremost of men, those illustrious heroes were filled with delight, their appearance indicating joy.

sa: एवमुक्त्वा तु बीभत्सुं सर्वास्तानब्रवीद् वचः। राज्ञश्च राजपुत्रांश्च पाण्डवानभिसंस्थितान्॥
en: Having thus spoken to Vibhatsu' he said to all the kings and princes present there, the following words. in rage.

sa: अयमस्मि स्थितो राजन् शमाय समराय च॥ तस्यायमागतः कालः समरस्य नराधिप!
en: I remain here, O king, ready for peace or for war; remember that the time for that fight is now come, O ruler of men.

sa: निमीलिताक्षं तं वीरं साश्रुकण्ठस्तदा वृषः। भीष्म भीष्म महाबाहो इत्युवाच महाद्युतिः॥
en: Then the highly effulgent Vrisha (Karna), with voice with tears of grief, approaching that hero lying with his eyes shut, fell at his two feet.

sa: अनुजानीष्व मां तात युद्धाय कृतनिश्चयम्। अनुज्ञातस्त्वया वीर युद्ध्येयमिति मे मतिः॥
en: Determined as I am to fight, it behaves you, O sire, to accord me your permission. With your permission, O hero, I intend to fight.

sa: आयुधानामहं वज्रं धेनूनामस्मि कामधुक्। प्रजनश्चास्मि कन्दर्पः सर्पाणामस्मि वासुकिः॥
en: I am thunder among weapons; I am Kamadhuka among cows; I am Kandarpa that generates. I am Vasuki among serpents;

sa: नारायणं नमस्कृत्य नरं चैव नरोत्तमम्। देवी सरस्वतीं व्यासं ततो जयमुदीरयेत्।।
en: Having saluted the Supreme Deity (Narayana) and the highest of all male beings Nara and also the Goddess of Learning (Sarasvati), let us cry "Success"!

sa: न ह्यज्ञातमसाध्यं वा तस्य संख्येऽस्ति किंचन। तेन छुपात्तं सकलं सर्वज्ञानमितस्ततः॥
en: There is nothing unknown to him, nothing incapable of being achieved by him battle, he who have acquired all knowledge of warfare from different quarters."

sa: गान्धारे युधि विक्रम्य निर्जिताः सुरसत्तमाः। पुरा वृत्रेण दैत्येन भिन्नदेहाः सहस्रशः॥
en: O Son of Gandhari, in days gone by, the Asura named Vritra, exerting his might in battle, had defeated the foremost of celestials in battle.

sa: सा तदाऽऽसीद् भृशं सेना व्याकुलाश्वरथद्विपा। विपन्नभूयिष्ठनरा कृपणा ध्वस्तमानसा॥
en: Then that host, with its elephants, horses and car-warriors, was much distressed and exceedingly jeopardised and rendered helpless and terror-stricken.

sa: सूतपुत्रं चतुःषष्ट्या विद्ध्वा सिंह इवानदन्। भल्लाभ्यां साधुमुक्ताभ्यां छित्त्वा कर्णस्य कार्मुकम्।।
en: Then with two well-directed broad-headed shafts he burst open Karna's bow; and once more he pierced Karna on the arms and breast with three shafts.

sa: ज्ञानयज्ञेन चाप्यन्ये यजन्तो मामुपासते। एकत्वेन पृथक्त्वेन बहुधा विश्वतोमुखम्॥
en: Others again, performing the Sacrifice of knowledge, worship Me as one, as distinct, as pervading the universe in many forms

sa: संजय उवाच प्रागायता महाराज षडेते वर्षपर्वताः। अवगाढा [भयतः समुद्रौ पूर्वपश्चिमौ॥
en: Sanjaya said Stretching from east to west, there are six mountains that are all equal and that extend from the eastern to the western sea.

sa: अभ्यतिष्ठत् पदा भूमौ सहाश्वं सहसारथिम्। शूरान् प्रहरतो दृष्ट्वा कृतास्त्रान् रुधिरोक्षितान्॥
en: Many weak-hearted cowards overwhelmed with swoons at the sight of heroes accomplished in the use of weapons fighting with one another, literally bathed in blood.

sa: श्रुत्वा सर्वाणि सैन्यानि त्रासं यास्यन्ति भारत। कपिध्वजस्तोत्पततो रथस्यामित्रकर्षिणः॥
en: Hearing the sound of the conch Panchajannya and the twang of the bow Gandiva, all the soldiers will be terror-stricken.

sa: शिरः प्रध्वंसयामास वक्षस्याक्रम्य कुञ्जरः। अपरांश्चापरेऽमृद्नन् वारणाः पतितान् नरान्॥
en: Elephants crushed their heads having attacked them on the breast. Else-where might be seen elephants crushing other excellent prostrate warriors.

sa: यथा ह्यकर्णधारा नौ रथश्चासारथिर्यथा। द्रवेद् यथेष्टं तद्वत् स्याहते सेनापति बलम्॥
en: An army without a commander is like a boat with none to steer her through or like a chariot without a driver, going any where.

sa: संजय उवाच तथापि तव पुत्रस्य प्रियकामा विशाम्पते। यशः प्रवीरा लोकेषु रक्षन्तो द्रोणमन्वयुः॥
en: Sanjaya said In spite of all these, O ruler of men, many excellent heroes, desirous of doing good to your son and of keeping their reputation unsullied, followed Drona's track.

sa: सर्वभूतस्थितं यो मां भजत्येकत्वमास्थितः। सर्वथा वर्तमानोऽपि स योगी मयि वर्तते॥
en: He, who worships Me abiding in all creatures, and thinking that all is one, lives in Me, whatever may be the mode of his living.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच तेष्वनीकेषु भग्नेषु पाण्डुपुत्रेण संजय। चलितानां द्रुतानां च कथमासीन्मनो हि चः॥
en: Dhritarashtra said What, O Sanjaya, was the state of your mind when my army was routed and crushed by Pandu's son and when you speedily fled away from the field?

sa: ततो भीष्मो महास्त्राणि पातयामास भारत। मोहयन् पाण्डुपुत्राणां व्यूढं सैन्यं महाहवे।॥
en: Thereupon Bhishma endued with great prowess, discharged powerful weapons that confounded in that fierce encounter the array of troops belonging to the sons of Pandu.

sa: ततो युधिष्ठिरो राजा धृष्टद्युम्नधनंजयौ। अब्रवीत् सर्वतो यत्तैः कुम्भयोनिर्निवार्यताम्॥
en: Thereupon king Yudhishthira said Dhrishtadyumna and Dhananjaya, "Check the carrier of the pot-born Drona by surrounding him with great heed.

sa: लगुडायोगुडाश्मानः शतघ्नयश्च सशक्तयः। गदापरिघनिस्त्रिंशशूलमुद्गरपट्टिशाः॥ सकम्पनर्टिनखरा मुसलानि परश्वधाः। क्षुराः क्षुरप्रनालीका वत्सदन्तास्थिसन्धयः॥ चक्राणि विशिखाः प्रासा विविधान्यायुधानि च। प्रपेतुः शतशो दिग्भ्यः प्रदिग्भ्यश्चार्जुनं प्रति॥
en: Then clubs, iron-balls, Shataghnis, rocks, darts, maces, bludgeons, swords, tridents, mallets, battle-axes, kampanas scimitars, nails, Mushalas, axes, razors, horse-shoe-headed arrows, Nalikas, Vatsadantas and shafts of bony-heads, discuses, Vishikhas, lances and many other kinds of weapons began to fall upon Arjuna from all the cardinal and subsidiary points of the compass.

sa: एवं बहुविधा यज्ञा वितता ब्रह्मणो मुखे। कर्मजान् विद्धि तान् सर्वानेवं ज्ञात्वा विमोक्ष्यसे॥
en: Thus Sacrifices of various sorts are in the Vedas. Know them all as the results of actions; and knowing this, you will be freed (from the fetters of the world).

sa: सदृशं चेष्टते स्वस्याः प्रकृतेर्ज्ञानवानपि। प्रकृति यान्ति भूतानि निग्रहः किं करिष्यति॥
en: Even a man of knowledge acts according to his own nature. All beings follow Nature. What then restraints (of the organs of action) will avail?

sa: देवानां दानवानां च अवध्यस्तनयोऽस्तु मे। उपेतो वैष्णवास्त्रेण तन्मे त्वं दातुमर्हसि॥
en: Possessed of the Vaishnava weapon let my son be unslayable, both by the gods and the demons. It behoves you to grant me that weapon.

sa: कुञ्जराश्वनरानन्ये पातयन्ति स्म पत्रिभिः। तालमात्राणि चापानि विकर्षन्तो महारथाः॥
en: Other mighty car-warriors, stretching their bows full six cubits long, felled with their winged shafts numerous elephants, steeds and men.

sa: पृष्ठे समभवच्छ्रीमान् स्वयं राजा युधिष्ठिरः। भ्रातृभ्यां सहितो वीरो यमाभ्यां चारुविक्रमः॥
en: In its tail was the heroic and even prosperous king Yudhishthira himself endued with great prowess, and supported by his twin brothers Nakula and Sahadeva.

sa: श्रुतिविप्रतिपन्ना ते यदा स्थास्यति निश्चला। समाधावचला बुद्धिस्तदा योगमवाप्स्यसि॥
en: When your mind, confounded by (all) that you have heard, will stand firm in contemplation, then will you acquire devotion.

sa: यदा ते मोहकलिलं बुद्धिर्व्यतितरिष्यति। तदा गन्ताऽसि निर्वेदं श्रोतव्यस्य श्रुतस्य च॥
en: When your understanding (mind) has gone beyond all delusion, then will you attain to the indifference to all that you have heard or will hear.

sa: बुद्धियुक्तो जहातीह उभे सुकृतदुष्कृते। तस्माद् योगाय युज्यस्व योगः कर्मसु कौशलम्॥
en: Devotional men do not see the difference between good and bad works in this world. Therefore apply yourself to devotion. Cleverness in action is devotion.

sa: तेषां प्रद्रवतां भीमः पञ्चालानामितस्ततः॥ गजवाजिकृतः शब्दः सुमहान् समजायत।
en: When the Panchalas were flying on all sides, a defending and dreadful din was created by their elephants and steeds.

sa: यस्मिन् द्वीपे समाश्वस्य युध्यन्ते कुरवः परैः। तं निमग्नं नरव्याघ्र भीष्मं शंससि संजय॥
en: O Sanjaya, you tell me of the disappearance of Bhishma, that foremost of men who was our main stay and relying on whom, the Kurus were fighting with their enemies.

sa: निहतान प्राणिनः संख्ये द्रोणेन बलिना रणे। वहन्ती पितृलोकाय शतशो राजसत्तमम्॥
en: And, O foremost of kings, that bore in hundreds to the regions of the ancestral manes, beings slain by the powerful Drona in that battle.

sa: शतमायस्तु शकुनिः सहदेवं समाद्रवत्। सनियन्तृध्वजरथं विव्याध निशितैः शरैः॥
en: Shakuni conversant with hundred kinds of deceitful practices, encountered Sahadeva, piercing the latters charioteer, chariot and flagstaff with sharpened shafts.

sa: विविंशति भीमसेनो विंशत्या निशितैः शरैः। विद्ध्वा नाकम्पयद् वीरस्तदद्भुतमिवाभवत्॥
en: Bhimasena pierced Vivinsati with twenty keen-pointed shafts; but being so pierced, he did not tremble; and that was indeed marvelous.

sa: द्रुपदस्तु ततः क्रुद्धो भगदत्तं महारथम्। आजधानोरसि क्षिप्रं शरेणानतपर्वणा॥
en: Thereupon, wrought up with ire, king Drupada, swiftly struck the mighty car-warrior Bhagadatta on the chest with a close-jointed Shafi.

sa: भीमोऽपिनिष्क्रम्य तत: सुप्रतीकाग्रतोऽभवत्। भीमं करेणावनम्य जानुभ्यामभ्यताडयत्॥ ग्रीवायां वेष्टयित्वैनं स गजो हन्तुमैहत। करवेष्टं भीमसेनो भ्रमं दत्त्वा व्यमोचयत्॥
en: Holding down Bhima with its trunk, Supratika then struck him with its knees. And winding its trunk round the neck of Bhima, it really tried to kill him. Whirling round Bhimasena freed himself from the twine of the elephant's trunk.

sa: चेकितानोऽनुविन्देन युयुधे चातिभैरवम्। यथा देवासुरे युद्धे बलशक्रौ महाबलौ॥
en: The dreadful Chekitana fought with Anuvindha; they careered through the field of battle, disappearing at times and exciting great wonder.

sa: बाह्यमाभ्यन्तरं चैव चरन्तौ मार्गमुत्तमम्। ददृशाते महात्मानौ सपक्षाविव पर्वतौ॥
en: Then those two high-souled ones, careering inward and outward, in most excellent tracks, appeared like two mountains furnished with wings.

sa: अपि त्रैलोक्यराज्यस्य हेतोः किं नु महीकृते॥ निहत्य धार्तराष्ट्रान् नः का प्रीतिः स्याज्जनार्दन।
en: Not even for the sake of the sovereignty over the three worlds, much less for that of this earth! What pleasure will be ours, O Janardana, by killing Dhritarashtra's sons!

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच बहूनि सुविचित्राणि द्वन्द्वयुद्धानि संजय। त्वयोक्तानि निशम्याहं स्पृहयामि सचक्षुषाम्॥
en: Dhritarashtra said O Sanjaya, you have described to me various wonderful accounts of single combats; hearing them I envy those who are blessed with eyes.

sa: ततस्तूर्यनिनादाश्च शङ्खानां च सहस्रशः। सिंहनादाश्च संजजुर्भेरीणां च महास्वनाः॥
en: Then there arose the blare of trumpets and conchs by thousands, as also leonine roars and deafening sounds of drums.

sa: तथा प्राच्याः प्रतीच्याश्च दाक्षिणात्योत्तरापथाः। सर्वथाऽस्त्रेषु कुशलास्ते रक्षन्तु पितामहम्॥
en: Let all the troops for the east, west, north and south skilled in all weapons protect the grand father (Bhishma).

sa: स दुर्मुखं भ्रुवोर्मध्ये नाराचेनाभ्यताडयत्। तस्य तद् विबभौ वक्त्रं सनालमिव पङ्कजम्॥
en: As the latter struck Durmukha between his two eye-brows with a Naracha. Thereupon the countenance of Durmukha appeared charming like a lotus with its stem.

sa: एकाह्रा हि रणे भीष्मो नाशयेद् देवदानवान्। किं नु पाण्डुसुतान् युद्धे सबलान् सपदानुगान्॥
en: Bhishma was capable of destroying all the Daityas and Danavas in a single day; with how much ease then could he kill the Pandavas with all their soldiers and followers.

sa: अपर्याप्तं तदस्माकं बलं भीष्माभिरक्षितम्। पर्याप्तं त्विदमेतेषां बलं भीमाभिरक्षितम्॥
en: Our army protected by Bhishma is unlimited (more then sufficient) their army protected by Bhima is limited, (may be sufficient).

sa: तथा प्राच्याः प्रतीच्याश्च दाक्षिणात्योत्तरापथाः। सर्वथाऽस्त्रेषु कुशलास्ते रक्षन्तु पितामहम्॥
en: Let all the troops for the east, west, north and south skilled in all weapons protect the grand father (Bhishma).

sa: हस्तावापं सुबाहोस्तु भल्लेन युधि पाण्डवः। चिच्छेद तं चैव पुनः शरवर्षैरवाकिरत्॥
en: Then in that battle the son of Pandu, with a broad-headed arrow cut-off the finger-guard of Suvahu and also covered him over with arrowy showers.

sa: भूतशर्मा क्षेमशर्मा करकाशश्च वीर्यवान्। कलिङ्गाः सिंहलाः प्राच्याः शूराभीरा दशेरकाः॥ शका यवनकाम्बोजास्तथा हंसपथाश्च ये। ग्रीवायां शूर सेनाश्च दरदा मद्रकेकया:॥ गजाश्वरथपत्त्योघास्तस्थुः परमदंशिताः।
en: Kritavarman and the effulgent Gautama formed its eyes, Bhutasharman, Kshemasharman, the puissant Karakasha, the Kalingas, the Singhalas, the Easterners, the Sudras, the Ahiras, the Kambojas, as also the Hansapathas. The Surasenas, the Madras, the Kekayas, the Dronas, with hundreds and thousands of elephants, steeds chariots and foot-soldiers, formed its neck.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच धर्मक्षेत्रे कुरुक्षेत्रे समवेता युयुत्सवः। मामकाः पाण्डवाश्चैव किमकुर्वत संजय॥
en: Dhritarashtra said What did my sons and the Pandava do, o Sanjaya, when desirous of battle they all assembled on the holy field of Kurukshetra?

sa: न चाहं शीघ्रयानेऽद्य समर्थो वयसान्वितः। सेनामुर न च पार्थानामेतद् बलमुपस्थितम्॥
en: Grown up in years, I cannot indeed proceed so has ily. Moreover, there! do you see the whole army of the Parthas assailing our van.

sa: तावकानां परेषां च युध्यतां भरतर्षभ। नासीत् कश्चिन्महाराज योऽत्याक्षीत् संयुगं भयात्।।३४
en: O foremost of the Bharatas, then there was none among your or the enemy's host, who, O mighty monarch, forsook the fight out of fear.

sa: समुच्छ्रितपताकानां गजानां परमद्विपैः। क्षणेन तुमुलो घोरः संग्रामः समपद्यत॥
en: And in a moment a dreadful battle raged between elephants bearing raised standards and their powerful rivals rushing at them.

sa: ववाशिरे च दीप्तायां दिशि गोमायुवायसाः। लिप्समानाः शरीराणि मांसशोणितभोजनाः॥
en: Carnivorous animals, jacks and crows cried from all directions which appeared in a blaze expecting to feed on (dead) bodies.

sa: संजय उवाच उभे सेने तुल्यमिवोपयाते उभे व्यूहे हृष्टरूपे नरेन्द्र। उभे चित्रे वनराजिप्रकाशे तथैवोभे नागरथाश्वपूर्णे॥
en: Sanjaya said O king, when placed in battle-array, both the armies were equally cheerful. Both the armies looked equally beautiful. They looked like two blossoming woods, and they were full of elephants, cars and horses.

sa: एवं स भगवान देवो लोकस्त्रष्टा महेश्वरः। देवासुरगणाध्यक्षो लोकानां विदधे शिवम्॥
en: Thus the illustrious god, that creator of the universe, that superior lord of the gods and the Assuras Maheshvara achieved good for all the worlds.

sa: अश्वत्थामानमासाद्य वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह। युध्यतेऽसौ रणे कर्णो दंशितः सर्वपार्थिवैः॥
en: Approached Ashvatthama and then said these words-"Yonder Karna, with his armour on, is seen (fighting) with all the (hostile) kings.

sa: शल्य कर्णोऽजुनेनाद्य योद्धव्यमिति मन्यते॥ तस्य त्वं पुरुषव्याघ्र नियच्छ तुरगान् युधि।
en: O Shalya, Karna thinks that he should fight with Arjuna today. So you, O foremost of men, restrain his horses in the field of battle.

sa: तमेवमुक्तवाप्यनुनीय चासकृत् तवात्मजः स्वाननुशास्ति सैनिकान्। विनिघ्नदाभिद्रवताहितान् मम स बाण हस्ताः किमु जोषमासत॥
en: Saying these words humbly again and again to Drona's son, your son commanded his army, saying-"Armed with shafts proceed against the enemies and kill them; why are you standing inactive?"

sa: ताबुभौ प्रजिहीर्षस्ताविन्द्रवृत्राविव प्रभौ। भीमरूपधरावास्तां महाधूमाविव ग्रहौ॥
en: O master, they looked like two fearful comets when they engaged in that deadly fight.

sa: अलं दुतेन वः शूरास्तिष्ठध्वं क्षत्रियर्षभाः॥ एष पार्थवधायाहं स्वयं गच्छामि संयुगे।
en: Heroes, do not take to flight! O best of the Kshatriyas, stay! I am myself going against Partha in order to slay him in battle.

sa: विद्धोऽस्मि वीराशु भृशं त्वयाद्य सहस्व भूयोऽपि गजाप्रहारम्। उक्तैवमुच्चैः कुपितोऽथ भीमो जग्राह तां भीमगदां वधाय॥
en: He told your son, "you have wounded me very soon; O brave warrior, you have also distressed me now, bear the weight of my mace.” Now catching hold of his formidable mace for killing Dushasana.

sa: आगमिष्यति निर्वेद धर्मपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः॥ दृष्ट्वा विनिहतान् संख्ये पञ्चालान् सोमकैः सह।
en: Beholding the destruction of the Panchalas as well well as of the Somakas in battle, Yudhishthira, the lord of Dharma, will experience a great pain.

sa: मध्यंदिनगतं सूर्य प्रतपन्तमिवाम्बरे। न शेकुः सर्वभूतानि पाण्डवं प्रतिवीक्षितुम्॥
en: Then all the creatures were unable to look at Pandu's son, who then resembled the sun shining on the meridian,

sa: ॥ तत्र गच्छ स्वयं शीघ्रं तांश्च रक्षस्व रक्षिणः॥ इहैव त्वहमासिष्ये प्रेषयिष्यामि चापरान्।
en: Therefore do you hie yourself to that spot and endeavour to protect those protectors of the Sindhus king. I shall stay here and dispatch others (for helping the Sindhu king).

sa: स्तथा रथान् पत्तिगणांश्च तान् बहूना जघान भोजस्तु हयानथापतन् क्षणाद् विशस्ताः कृतवर्मणः शरैः॥
en: Kritavarma then killed the huge elephants, horses, chariots and a number of the troops of infantry. He fell down on the ground within moment when their bodies were damaged severely.

sa: सर्वे देवगणाश्चैव सर्वभूतानि यानि च। यतः पार्थस्ततो देवा यतः कर्णस्ततोऽसुराः॥
en: All the Gods favoured Partha and the Asuras Karna and all the creations felt an interest either for the Pandava warrior or the Kuru warrior.

sa: तत्र स्म राक्षसी गाति सदा कृष्णचतुर्दशीम्॥ नगरे शाकले स्फीते आहत्य निशि दुन्दुभि।
en: In the large and populous city of Shakala a Rakshasa woman used to sing on every fourteenth day of the dark half of the month in accompaniment with a drum.

sa: किरंस्तु शरवर्षाणि रोचमान इवांशुमान्। धृष्टद्युम्नो महाराज द्रोणमभ्यद्रवद् रणे॥
en: Appearing beautiful like the sun and scattering showers of arrows, Dhrishtadyumna, O mighty monarch, rushed upon Drona in that battle.

sa: समासाद्य तु ते कर्ण व्यशीर्यन्त महारथाः। यथाचलं समासाद्य वार्योधाः सर्वतोदिशम्॥
en: Encountering Karna those great carwarriors were scattered (by him) as a collection of water is dispersed on all sides while dashing against a huge mountain.

sa: परस्परवधे यत्तौ सर्वभूतभयङ्करौ॥ अयुध्येतां महाबाहू चित्रं लघु च सुष्ठु च।
en: And bent on killing each other and filling all the creatures with consternation, those two mighty-armed (heroes) fought admirably and with (great nimbleness and dexterity).

sa: समासादयितुं शतो न च मां धर्षयिष्यति। धृष्टद्युम्नश्च समरे द्रोणं क्रुद्धं परंतपः॥ वारयिष्यति विक्रम्य वेलेव मकरालयम्। यत्र स्थास्यति संग्रामे पार्षतः परवीरहा॥
en: Will be able to defeat or afflict us. Dhrishtadyumna also that scorcher of foes, putting forth all his prowess in battle will hold the enraged Drona in check like the banks resisting the mighty main. In battle, where that slayer of foes viz., the son of Prisata will present him.

sa: तदुपश्रुत्य मघवा प्रणिपत्य पितामहम्॥ व्यज्ञापयत देवेशमिदं मतिमतां वरः।
en: Hearing this Brahma and Ishana said to the king of the celestials the noble Vijaya (Arjuna) will surely gain victory.

sa: शपेऽहं कृष्णचरणैरिष्टापूर्तेन चैव ह। यदि त्वां ससतुं पापं न हन्यां युधि रोषितः॥
en: I swear today by Krishna's feet and all the meritorious acts that I had done before, that I will wrathfully kill you in battle together with your sons, with arrows.

sa: कृष्णः श्वेतान् महावेगानश्वान् काञ्चनभूषणान्। मुक्ताजालप्रतिच्छन्नान् प्रेषीत् कर्णरथं प्रति॥
en: But those swift horses of Arjuna decked with gold and strings of pearls were directed by Krishna towards Karna's car.

sa: तं दृष्ट्वा समुपायान्तं रुक्मपुङ्खः शिलाशितैः। दशभिः सात्वतस्यार्थे भीमो विव्याध सायकैः॥
en: Bhima, for the purpose of (helping) Sattavat, pierced the Kaurava (Somadatta) with ten (arrows). Somadatta too struck that hero in return with a hundred (darts).

sa: अपसव्यांस्तु तांश्चक्रे रथेन मधुसूदनः॥ न युक्तान् हि स तान् मेने यमायाशु किरीटिना।
en: And the destroyer of (Asura) Madhu, quite confident that Kiritin will soon send them to the region of Pluto, urged on the car, brought them all to the right side.

sa: युद्धसारेण वाक्येन असतां सम्मतेन च। नाहं भीषयितुं शक्यः क्षत्रवृत्ते स्थितस्त्वया॥
en: Observant of the practices of the Kshatriyas as I am, I can to be terrified with words smelling of battle and insulting to the virtuous.

sa: ततः शरं महाघोरं ज्वलन्तमिव पावकम्। मुमोच सात्वको राजन् स्वर्णपुङ्ख शिलाशितम्॥
en: He then discharged (at Somadatta himself) a highly dreadful arrow, blazing like the fire, furnished with golden wings, bathed in oil and sharpened on stone.

sa: सोऽतिविद्धो महाराज सात्वतेन महारथः। सोमदत्तो महाबाहुर्निपपात ममार च॥
en: The great car-warrior Somadatta, deeply pierced by the puissant Satvata, fell down (from his car) and died, O great king.

sa: चिच्छेद च धनुदीर्घ ब्राह्मणस्य च पाण्डवः। ततोऽन्यद् धनुरादत्त द्रोणः क्षत्रियमर्दनः॥
en: And the son of Pandu also cut-off the large bow of that Brahamana. Drona, the grinder of the Kshatriyas then, having taken up another bow.

sa: द्विपारोहान् द्विपांश्चैव हयारोहान् हयांस्तथा। रथिनः साश्वसूतांश्च जघानेशः पशूनिव॥
en: Elephant-riders and elephants, horse-men and horses and car-warriors and their steeds and charioteers, Satyaki slew like Rudra slaying the beasts.

sa: काक उवाच शतमेकं च पातानां पतिताऽस्मि न संशयः। शतयोजनमेकैकं विचित्रं विविधं तथा॥
en: The crow said Forsooth shall I fly displaying a hundred and one different kinds of motion. I shall show them traversing every hundred yojanas with each separate and beautiful motion.

sa: अथ हंसवचो मूढः कुत्सयित्वा पुनः पुनः। प्रजगादोत्तरं काकः कत्थनो जातिलाघवात्॥
en: Finding fault repeatedly with the words of the swans, the vain crow, on account of the foolishness of its species, at last gave this answer.

sa: विधुन्वानो धनुः श्रेष्ठं व्यभ्राजत महायशाः। भज्यमानं बलं राजन् सात्वतेन महात्मना॥
en: And stretching his mighty bow shone beautiful, endued as he was with great renown. Then, o king, the army routed by the illustrious Satvata hero.

sa: इषूणामक्षयत्वं च धनुषो गाण्डिवस्य च। अस्त्रैरस्त्राणि संवार्य द्रौणेः शारद्वतस्य च॥
en: The inexhaustibility of his shafts and the strength also of his bow Gandiva. Repulsing with his own weapons, those of Drona's son and of Kripa.

sa: ततो युधिष्ठिरो राजा मद्रराजानमाहवे। विद्ध्वा पञ्चाशताबाणैः पुनर्विव्याध सप्तभिः॥
en: King Yudhishthira having at first pierced the king of the Madras with five hundred arrows, again pierced him with seven.

sa: तमर्जुनः पृषत्कानां शतैः षड्भिरताडयत्। अत्यर्थमिव संक्रुद्धः प्रतिविद्धे जनार्दने॥
en: Then beholding Janardana pierced and excited to the highest pitch of fury, Arjuna struck his foe with six hundred arrows.

sa: तथान्यान् पाण्डुपुत्राणां समायातान् महारथान्। तावका रथिनो राजन् वारयामासुरोजसा॥
en: Similarly, o king, your car-warriors energetically opposed other great car-warriors of the sons of Pandu, who were advancing (Against Drona).

sa: प्रपद्यतस्तत् परमं परा भूतिर्विधीयते॥ गायन्ति चतुरो वेदा यश्च वेदेषु गीयते।
en: He that attains to your Supreme self enjoys the highest prosperity. The four Vedas sing of you and you are sung in the four Vedas.

sa: तौ हि वीरौ महेष्वासौ मदर्थे कुरुसत्तमौ। भीष्मद्रोणौ हतो श्रुत्वा नार्थो वै जीवितेऽसति॥
en: Having heard that those two mighty bowmen, the foremost of the Kurus, the heroic Bhishma and Drona, were slain for my sake, what necessity can I have for my life?

sa: तां धृतिं कुरु वैदेहाम्बष्ठ काम्बोजास्तथा नग्नजितस्त्वया। गान्धाराश्च यया धृत्या जिताः संख्ये सुदुर्जयाः। राधेय ततः प्रत्येहि पाण्डवम्॥ वासुदेवं च वार्ष्णेय प्रीयमाणं किरीटिना। प्रत्युद्याहि महाबाहो पौरुषे महति स्थितः॥
en: O son of Radha, you have worsted in battle the unconquerable Vaidehas, Abvasthas, Kambojas, Nagnajits and the Gandharas, now with the same energy and putting forth your best exertion and prowess, O mighty armed one, like a man, do you proceed onward and attack the son of Pandu, as also against Vasudeva, the descendant of Vrishni and who is always adorned by the crowned Arjuna.

sa: शतानीकस्ततो दृष्ट्वा भ्रातरं हतवाहनम्। रथेनाभ्यपतत् तूर्णं सर्वलोकस्य पश्यतः॥
en: Witnessing the destruction of his brother's steeds, Shatanika quickly came up (there), in the very sight of all the troops.

sa: वध्यमाना शरशतैः शल्येनाहवशोभिना। तां दृष्ट्वा विद्रुतां सेनां वासुदेवधनंजयौ॥
en: Slaughtered with hundreds of arrows by Shalya, that ornament of battle, witnessing the flight of that army, Vasudeva and Dhananjaya.

sa: एते द्रवन्ति समरे धार्तराष्ट्रा महारथाः। अर्जुनस्य भयात् तूर्णं निरपेक्षा जनाधिपाः॥
en: Not at all caring for the safety of others those chiefs, the principal warriors of Dhritarasthra army, are melting away, being afraid to face Arjuna.

sa: त्रिदशानपि वा युक्तान् सर्वशस्त्रधरान् युधि। वारयेद् यो रणे कर्णः सयक्षासुरमानुषान्॥
en: Indeed that Karna who is competent enough of resisting the celestials together with the Yakshas, Asuras and men all armed with numerous kinds of weapon.

sa: संजय उवाच सायाह्ने सैन्धवं हत्वा राज्ञा पार्थः समेत्य च। सात्यक्श्चि महेष्वासो द्रोणमेवाभ्यधावताम्॥
en: Sanjaya said Having killed the king of Sindhu in the evening Partha saw the king (i.e. Yudhishthira) and then united with the great bowman Satyaki he advanced against Drona himself.

sa: अवप्लुत्य रथात् तस्माचित्रसेनो महारथः। नाकुलिं पञ्चविंशत्या शराणामार्दयद् बली॥
en: Jumping down from his car, the highlyrenowned Chitrasena, possessed of (great) strength, oppressed the son of Nakula with twenty-five arrows.

sa: तं तूर्णमभिधावन्तं पञ्चाला जितकाशिनः। प्रत्युद्ययुर्महात्मानं हंसा इव महार्णवम्॥
en: The Panchalas, desirous of victory, advanced against that high-souled one who came quickly as the swans go to the ocean.

sa: स च्छिन्नधन्वा विरथो हताश्वो हतसारथिः। आरुरोहं रथं तूर्णं हार्दिक्यस्य महात्मनः॥
en: His bow cut-off and deprived of his car, steeds and charioteer, he (i.e. Chitrasena) quickly mounted on the car of the high-souled son of Hridika.

sa: ततः पाञ्चाल्यसेनानां भृशमासीद् रवो महान्॥ हतो राजेति राजेन्द्र मुदितानां समन्ततः।
en: Then a great and tumultuous uproar arose from among the Panchala soldiers. O king of kings, that great noise was this “the king is slain.”

sa: एतत् कूजित गाण्डिवंन विसृष्ट सव्यसाचिना। एते हस्तवता मुक्ता मन्त्यमित्राशिताः शराः॥
en: This is twang sound coming from the stretched Gandiva of Savyasanchi (Arjuna). These arrows shot by Arjuna are very acute and killing ceaselessly the enemies.

sa: सती पुरा हृता काचिदारट्टात् किल दस्युभिः। अधर्मतंश्योपयाता सा तानभ्यशपत् ततः॥
en: In the days of yore a chaste woman of the country of Aratta was abducted by robbers; they violated her, on which she imprecated a

sa: ततोऽस्त्रमस्त्रेण परस्परं तौ विधूय वाताविव पूर्वपश्चिमौ॥ घनान्धकारे वितते तमोनुदौ यथोदितौ तद्वदतीव रेजतुः।
en: The two brave warriors thwarted one another's weapons, like the East and West winds struggling with each other and looked brilliant like the sun or the moon after dispelling darkness.

sa: एतच्छ्रुत्वा वचस्तस्य गोविन्दः प्रहसन्निव॥ अब्रवीदर्जुनं तूर्ण कौरवाञ्जहि पाण्डव।
en: Hearing these words of his, Govind smiled and addressing Arjuna said-"O son of Pandu, go on killing the Kauravas indiscriminately."

sa: पर्यधावन्त पञ्चाला वध्यमाना महात्मना। रुक्मपुखैः प्रसन्नाग्रैस्तव पुत्रेण धन्विना॥
en: The Panchalas, struck with gold-winged darts of blazing points, shot by your highsouled son armed with a bow, fled away.

sa: पत्तयश्च महाबाहो शतशः शस्त्रपाणयः। अन्योन्यमार्दयन् राजन् नित्यंयत्ताः पराक्रमे॥
en: O mighty-armed one, O tormentor of foes, hundreds of foot-soldiers armed with weapons rushed against one another with vigorous efforts.

sa: युधिष्ठरो भूतहिते रतः सदा वृकोदरपस्तद्वशगस्तथा यमौ। त्वया तु पाथैश्च कृते च संविदे प्रजाः शिवं प्राप्नुयुरिच्छया तव॥ व्रजन्तु शेषाः स्वपुराणि बान्धवा निवृत्तयुद्धाश्च भवन्तु सैनिकाः। न चेद् वचः श्रोष्यसि मे नराधिप ध्रुवं प्रतप्तासि हतोऽरिभियुधि॥
en: Yudhishthira always seeks the welfare of all creatures. Vrikodara and the twins (Nakul and Sahadeva) are always under Yudhishthira's order; and if you make peace it would appear that you make it only for the welfare of all parties. All the kings then will return to their respective homes and the troops will no longer fight with each other; if you do not hear my advice you will have to repent hereafter when you will be crushed by your enemies.

sa: तमायान्तं समीक्ष्यैव श्वेताश्वं कृष्णसारथिम्। मद्रराजोऽब्रवीत् कर्णं केतुं दृष्ट्वा महात्मनश्च :॥
en: Looking at the standard, the white steeds and the black driver, (Krishna) of the noble Arjuna, Shalya, the king of Madra, addressing Karna, said son

sa: दुर्योधन हि राजेन्द्र मुदा परमया युतः॥ वादयामास संहृष्टो नानावाद्यानि सर्वशः।
en: O king of kinds, Duryodhana being very glad ordered in great glee his war bands to discourse music throughout the whole range of his army.

sa: अयं स वैकर्तन युद्धकालो विदर्शयस्वात्मबलं महात्मन्। यथा न वध्येत रणेऽर्जुनेन जयद्रथः कर्ण तथा कुरुष्व॥
en: O son of Vikartana, the crisis in the battle has arrived. O high-souled warriors, now show your own strength. O Karna, do you so act as Jayadratha may not be slain in battle by Arjuna.

sa: न मामस्मादभिप्रायात् कश्चिदद्य निवतये । अपीन्द्रो वज्रमुद्यम्य किमु मर्त्यः कचन॥
en: No one will be able to make me change this resolution, not even Indra taking up his thunderbolt, what to speak of an insignificant mortal?

sa: अस्त्राणि पश्याद्य ममोत्तमानि ब्राह्माणि दिव्यान्यथ मानुषाणि॥ आसादयिष्याम्यहमुग्रवीर्य द्विपो द्विपं मत्तमिवातिमत्तः।
en: Behold today all my excellent weapons, Brahma, celestial and human, I will like today that highly powerful heroes like an infuriate elephants slaying another such.

sa: सरथं कृतवर्माणं समन्तात् पर्यवारयत्॥ छादयित्वारणे राजन् हार्दिक्यं स तु सात्यकिः।
en: And with that arrowy shower, he then completely covered Kritavarman and his chariot. Thus covering the son of Hridika, O monarch, Satyaki in that battle.

sa: नाहं विभेमि कृष्णाभ्यां विजानन्नात्मनो बलम्। वासुदेवसहस्रं वा फाल्गुनानां शतानि वा॥ अहमेको हनिष्यामि जोषमास्स्व कुदेशज।
en: I know my strength well and I do not fear the two Krishnas. I will kill single handed a thousand Vasudevas and hundreds of Phalgunas. Hold your tongue. O you born in a sinful country.

sa: तथोत्तमौजा: संक्रुद्धः शरैर्हेमविभूषितैः। अविध्यत् सारथिं चास्य प्राहिणोद् यमसादनम्॥
en: Similarly Uttamoujas waxing wroth pierced Duryodhana's charioteer with arrows decked with gold and dispatched him to the abode of Death.

sa: त्रासयन् स्थघोषेण क्षत्रियान् क्षत्रियर्षभः। राजीवलोचनं कर्णं सात्यकिः प्रत्यविध्यत॥
en: 0 king, that encounter between the powerful Satyaki and the high-souled Karna looked like the encounter between Bali and Vasava.

sa: शत्रुः शदेः शासतेर्वा श्यतेर्वा शृणातेर्वा श्वसतेः सीदतेर्वा॥ उपसर्गाद् बहुधा सूदतेश्च प्रा येण सर्वं त्वयि तच मह्यम्।
en: Whereas he who destroys, remonstrates with, sharpens his weapons, makes us to sigh and cheerless and wrongs us in many ways is our enemy. All these marks are to be seen in you and you display them all against us.

sa: अप्रियो यः पुरुषो निष्ठुरो हि क्षुद्रः क्षेप्ता क्षमिणंश्चाक्षमावान्॥ हन्यामहं तादृशानां शतानि क्षमाम्यहं क्षमया कालयोगात्।
en: The forgiving always forgive a mean and a cruel person who performs unpleasant deeds. I can slay a hundred like you, but I forgive you for my forgiving nature and the necessity of the time.

sa: ऊरुप्रभेदाच महान् बभूव शरीरतो मे घनशोणितौधः। गुरोभयाचापि न चेलिवानहं ततो विबुद्धो ददृशे स विप्रः॥
en: On account of this boring of my thigh a pool of thick blood gushed out of my body. For fear of my preceptor I did not move my limb. The Brahmana, on waking, saw it.

sa: आहूतो न निवर्तेयमिति तस्य महाव्रतम्। स्वयं मार्गयितव्यः स सूतपुत्रेण फाल्गुनः॥
en: "Challenged, I would never turn back" even this was the vow taken by Arjuna. The son of Suta should therefore have summoned Arjuna in battle.

sa: षट्साहना भारत राजपुत्राः स्वर्गाय लोकाय रणे निमग्नाः। कर्ण न चेदद्य निहन्मि राजन् सबान्धवं युध्यमानं प्रसह्य॥ प्रतिश्रुत्याकुर्वतो वै गतिर्या कष्टा याता तामहं राजसिंह।
en: Six thousands of kings are giving their lives for heaven. If however, O king, displaying all my strength I do not kill Karna with is allies in battle, I shall be doomed, O lion among kings to the curse which falls to the lot of one who promises a thing and does not redeem it.

sa: द्रोणाय निहतं शंस राजशारद्वतीसुतम्॥ त्वयोक्तो नैव युध्येत जातु राजन् द्विजर्षभः।
en: O monarch, inform Drona that the son of Saradvat's daughter is dead. Thus spoken by you that foremost of the Brahmanas will cease to fight.

sa: तत्तु दुर्योधनः श्रुत्वा द्रोणपुत्रस्य भाषितम्। घोरमप्रियमाख्यातुं नाशक्नोत् पार्थिवर्षभः॥
en: 0 Bharata, has any great catastrophe, O mighty monarch, overtaken your army? Thereafter Duryodhana hearing the words of Drona's son.

sa: अन्येष्वपि च युद्धेषु नैव सेनाद्रवत् तदा। कचित् क्षेमं महाबाहो तव सैन्यस्य भारत॥
en: In consequence of the slaughter of what foremost of warriors of your army have the troops been reduced to this plight? O foremost of the Kurus, tell me all truly.

sa: किमियं द्रवते सेना त्रस्तरूपेव भारत। द्रवमाणां च राजेन्द्र नावस्थापयसे रणे॥
en: Approached Duryodhana; and then that son of Drona said these words to the latter-"Why O Bharata, are the troops flying away, as if in fear?

sa: पुनश्च सूतपुत्रं तु स्वर्णपुजैः शिलाशितैः। सुमुक्तेश्चित्रवर्माणं निर्बिभेद त्रिसप्तभिः॥
en: Once more with twenty one whetted shafts furnished with wings and duly discharged, Bhimasena pierced Suta's son of variegated armour.

sa: चिकीर्षुर्दुष्करं कर्म धृष्टद्युम्नो महारथः। इयेष वक्षो भेत्तुं स भारद्वाजस्य संयुगे।॥
en: Then that mighty car-warrior Dhristadyumna, out of foolishness and for achieving a difficult feat, wished to tear open the breast of Bharadvaja's son in battle.

sa: संजय उवाच ततो द्रोणे हते राजन् कुरवः शस्रपीडितः। हतप्रवीरा विध्वस्ता भृशं शोकपरायणाः॥
en: Sanjaya said Upon the slaughter of Drona, O king, the Kurus, afflicted with the weapons of their enemies, their foremost warrior slain and themselves confounded-began to indulge copiously in grief,

sa: ततः क्रुद्धो महाराज तव पुत्रो महारथः। पाण्डुपुत्रौ महेष्वासौ वारयामास पत्रिभिः॥
en: Thereupon, O king, your son, the great carwarrior, being greatly enraged resisted those the rays twin sons of Pandu, the great bowmen, with numberless arrows.

sa: ततो रणे भारत दुष्प्रकम्प्य आचार्यपुत्रः प्रवरः कुरूणाम्। जनार्दनं चैव विषाग्निकल्पैः॥
en: Later on in the battle, the invincible preceptor's son, the foremost of Kuru warriors, afflicted me and Janardana with arrows poignant like poison and fire.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच पाण्ड्ये हते किमकरोदर्जुनो युधि संजय। एकवीरेण कर्णेन द्रावितेषु परेषु च॥
en: Dhritarashtra said O Sanjaya, on the slaughter of Pandya and also while that foremost of warriors, Karna, destroyed the hostile force, what did Arjuna do in the field of battle?

sa: कर्णश्च शरवर्षेण गौतमश्च महारथः। दुर्योधनादयस्ते च शैनेयं पर्यवारयन्॥
en: Karna and the son of Gotama, that mighty car-warrior and Duryodhana and others, then covered Shini's grandson with their shafts.

sa: तेषु प्रक्षीयमाणेषु पाण्डवेयेषु भारत। जरासंधसुतो वीरः स्वयं द्रोणमुपाद्रवत्॥
en: While the Pandava troops were being thus reduced in number, O Bharata, the brave son of Jarasandha rushed against, Drona.

sa: न स जातु महाबाहुर्भारमुद्यम्य सीदति। ये च सौवीरका योधास्तथा सैन्धपौरवाः॥
en: That mighty-armed one will never succumb under the heaviest of burdens. Those warriors that are ranged against him viz., the Souvirakas, the Sindhus, the Pauravas.

sa: अभयं सर्वभूतानां प्रददौ योगमीयिवान्। तस्य तच्छिद्रमाज्ञाय धृष्टद्युम्नः प्रतापवान्॥
en: Then betaking to yoga, he assuredly gave safety to creature. Taking advantage of that opportunity. Dhristadyumna collected all his energies.

sa: भारद्वाजं समासाद्य व्यूहस्य प्रमुखे स्थितम्। अयोधयन् रणे पार्था द्रोणानीकं बिभित्सवः॥
en: Then the Parthas desirous of breaking through the Kuru array fought vigorously with Bharadvaja's son Drona, having encountered him at the head of his array.

sa: भौमेन रजसाऽऽकीर्णे शस्त्रसम्पातसंकुले। नैव स्वे न परे राजन् व्यज्ञायन्त तमोवृताः॥
en: When everything was covered with dust raised by the weapons, they, O king, could not recognise who were their own and who were their enemies.

sa: यत्तन्मया बाणसमर्पितेन ध्यातोऽसि कर्णस्य वधाय वीर। तन्मे त्वया कचिदमोघमद्य ध्यानं कृतं कर्णनिपातनेन॥
en: O valiant one, afflicted with Karna's shafts today how I thought of you (that you would slay him)! Have you put that thought of mine to action by slaying Karna?

sa: ते भुजा भोगिभोगाभाश्चन्दनाक्ता विशाम्पते। लोहितार्दा भृशं रेजुस्तपनयध्वजा इव॥
en: O king, those arms, resembling the bodies of serpents, pasted with gold and besmeared with blood, appeared like little mountains.

sa: सोऽतिविद्धो महाराज पुत्रस्तेऽतिव्यराजत॥ वसन्तकाले सुमहान् प्रफुल्ल इव किंशुकः।
en: Being deeply wounded, O king, your son looked exceedingly grand like a Kinshuka tree full of flowers in the spring.

sa: ध्वजमेकेन बाणेन चिच्छेदाञ्जनपर्वणः। द्वाभ्यां तु रथयन्तारौ त्रिभिश्चास्य त्रिवेणुकम्॥
en: Cut off the standard of Anjanaparva with one arrow, his two charioteers with two and his Trivenduka with four (arrows).

sa: स शल्येनाभ्युपगते हयानां संनियच्छने। कर्णो हृष्टमना भूयो दुर्योधनमभाषत॥
en: When the drivership of his horses was accepted by Shalya, Karna became highly once gratified and more addressed Duryodhana, saying-

sa: याहि याहिति गोविन्दं मुहुर्मुहुरचोदयत्। तां युद्धभूमिं पार्थस्य दर्शयित्वा च माधवः॥ त्वरमाणस्ततः कृष्णः पार्थमाह शनैरिदम्। पश्य पाण्डव राजानमुपयातांश्च पार्थिवान्॥
en: Arjuna frequently was saying god Krishna to march ahead. God Krishna proceeded forward by duly introducing Arjuna with the battle-field in haste. He said to Arjuna in a slow voice-O son of Pandu! See that a number of kings have already accessed to the king.

sa: कृप उवाच तवैतत् क्षम्यतेऽस्माभिः सूतात्मज सुदुर्मते। दर्पमुत्सितमेतत् ते फाल्गुनो नाशयिष्यति॥
en: Kripa said 0 Charioteer's of very wicked understanding, you are pardoned by us of this (fault). But Phalguna will (soon) destroy your swelling pride. son

sa: विस्मिताश्चाभवन् केचित् केचिदासन्नमर्षिताः। हस्तैर्हस्ताग्रमपरे प्रत्यपिंषन् नराधिपाः॥
en: Some were filled with wonder and some could not beer him. Some rubbed their hands.

sa: तथा चरन्तं संग्रामे भृशं समरदुर्जयम्। द्रुपदस्य ततः पौत्रास्त्रय एव विशाम्पते॥
en: Who, invincible as he was in battle, was roving freely on the field. Then O ruler of men, the grandsons of Drupada, in three number.

sa: दृष्ट्वा कर्णं महाबाहुमुच्चैः शब्दमथानदन्। अयं कर्णः कुतः कर्णस्तिष्ठ कर्ण महारणे॥
en: Seeing Karna, possessed of mighty arms, sent forth loud shouts. (And the said)-"This is Karna! where is Karna! O Karna, stay in this great battle.

sa: स तु दुःशासनं शूरं सायकैरावृणोद् भृशम्। सशकं समनुप्राप्तमूर्णनाभिरिवोर्णया॥
en: That subduer of foes then quickly covered Dushasana with his arrows like a spider cntangling a gnat in its web.

sa: युध्यस्व सहितोऽस्माभिर्दुरात्मन् पुरुषाधम। अन्ये तु दृष्ट्वा राधेयं क्रोधरक्तेक्षणाऽब्रुवन्॥
en: O wicked-souled one, O vilest of men, give us battle. Others, with eyes burning in ire on beholding Karna, said.

sa: यादृक् क्षयमनीकानामकरोत् सात्यकिर्नृप। अत्यर्जुनं शिनेः पौत्रो युध्यते पुरुषर्षभः॥
en: As was done by Satyaki in your ranks. O foremost of men, Sini's grandson then fought, surpassing even Arjuna himself.

sa: अपरे जगृहुश्चैव केशवस्य महाभुजौ॥ पार्थमन्ये महाराज रथस्थं जगृहुर्मुदा।
en: O sire, Some among them seized the long arins of Kesava and others seized Arjuna who was on his car.

sa: कर्णः प्राच्छादयत् क्रुद्धो भीमं सायकवृष्टिभिः। तत्र भारत भीमस्य बलं वीर्ये पराक्रमम्॥ व्यवसायं च पुत्रास्ते ददृशुः सहसैनिकाः। तां समुद्रमिवोद्धतां शरवृष्टिं समुत्थिताम्॥ अचिन्तयित्वा भीमस्तु क्रुद्धः कर्णमुपाद्रवत्। रुक्मपृष्ठं महचापं भीमस्यासीद् विशाम्पते॥
en: Karna, excited to the highest pitch of fury, poured on Bhima his arrowy showers; then 0 Bharata, your sons and their soldiers all beheld the mighty energy, prowess and perseverance of Bhima inasmuch as the latter, unmindful of that shower of arrows resembling the furious ocean, dashed with wrath against Karna. O monarch, Bhima then wielded a bow that was formidable and the back of which was adorned with gold.

sa: इति तेषां प्रतिश्रुत्य मध्ये सर्वधनुष्मताम्। आयाद द्रोणं सहानीकः पाञ्चाल्यः परवीरहा॥
en: Thus having sworn in the midst of all bowmen, that slayer of foes, viz., the Panchala prince rushed upon Drona, supported by his own division.

sa: स्थैर्हया हयैर्नागाः पादातैश्चापि कुञ्जराः। हयैर्हयाः समाजग्मुः पादाताश्च पदातिभिः॥
en: Horsemen fought with car-warriors and elephants with horsemen and foot-soldier with elephants and horsemen with horsemen and infantry with infantry.

sa: विकिरज्छरजालानि सर्वतो भैरवस्वनान्। शत्रून् निपातयिष्यामि महावात इव दुमान्॥
en: Shooting on all sides shafts of dreadful whirl, I shall fell my foes like the mighty tempest uprooting the trees.

sa: उद्यतप्रतिपिष्टानां खङ्गानां वीरबाहुभिः। स एव शब्दस्तद्रूपो वाससां निज्यतामिव॥
en: The whizz, of lifted and descending swords, wielded by the arms of heroes, resembled that of clothes thrashed for wash.

sa: भृयामिष्वसनादद्य मत्प्रयुक्ता महाहवे। दर्शयन्तः शरा वीर्य प्रमथिष्यन्ति पाण्डवान्॥
en: In today's mighty battle, shafts shot furiously from by bow will crush and mangle the Pandavas, showing their great energy.

sa: तावेवान्ये समासाद्य जग्मुर्वैवस्वतक्षयम्। आविग्नमभवत् सर्वं कौरवाणां महद् बलम्॥
en: Meeting them both their opponents went to regions of Death. Then the mighty host of the Kurus became greatly agitated.

sa: पुत्रस्तव महाराज राजा दुर्योधनो द्रुतम्। ततः प्रतिचिकीर्षन्तमपसव्यं तु ते सुतम्॥
en: Your son the king Duryodhana then began to fight wonderfully. O mighty monarch. Then as your son endeavoured to counteract Nakula even from his sight.

sa: स निवृत्तस्ततः कर्णः संघट्टित इवोरगः। भीममावारयामास विकिरन् निशिताञ्छरान्॥
en: Thereupon like a snake struck with a stick Karna wheeled back and covered Bhima by scattering sharp arrows by thousands.

sa: संजय उवाच तस्मिस्तथा वर्तमाने गजाश्वनरसंक्षये। दुःशासनो महाराज धृष्टद्युम्नमयोधयत्॥
en: Sanjaya said When that battle, destructive of men, horses and elephants, thus progressed, O mighty monarch, Dushasana fought with Dhristadyumna.

sa: दुःशासनस्तु राजेन्द्र पाञ्चाल्यस्य महात्मनः। नाशकत् प्रमुखे स्थातुं शरजालप्रपीडितः॥
en: Then, O foremost of kings, Dushasana, being afflicted with the arrows of Panchalas, could not stay before that illustrious warriors.

sa: स तु दुःशासनं बाणैविर्मुखीकृत्य पार्षतः। किरञ्छरसहस्राणि द्रोणमेवाभ्ययाद् रणे॥
en: Thus the son of Prisata, having repulsed Dushasana with his arrows, assailed Drona shooting thousands of shafts as he proceeded.

sa: ततोऽब्रवीदर्जुनो भीमसेनं संशप्तकाः प्रत्यनीकं स्थिता मे। मितोऽपयातुं रिपुसङ्घगोष्ठात्॥
en: Then Arjuna said to Bhimasena-"The Samsaptakas are before my army, without killing these my enemies I cannot leave the post."

sa: कस्माद् भवान् महाखङ्गं परिगृह्णाति सत्वरः। तत् त्वां पृच्छामि कौन्तेयं किमिदं ते चिकीर्षितम्॥ परामृशसि यत् क्रुद्धः खङ्गमद्भुतविक्रम।
en: Why do you seize your mighty sword so suddenly, I enquire this of you. O Kaunteya, whence is this desire of your heart, or why do you fly to sword in such a sullen mood and with such a vigour?"

sa: आचार्याणां भवन्त्येव रहस्यानि महात्मनाम्। तानि पुत्राय वा दधुः शिष्यायानुगताय वा॥
en: This is the mystery about all illustrious preceptors, that they impart the knowledge of their respective sciences of their sons or to their beloved pupils.

sa: तमधर्मेण धर्मिष्ठं धृष्टद्युम्नेन संयुगे। श्रुत्वा निहतमाचार्यं सोऽश्वत्थामा किमब्रवीत्॥
en: Hearing that the pious preceptor has been slain in battle by unfair means by Dhristadyumna what did that Ashvatthama say?

sa: बभूव तुमुलं युद्धं तयोः पुरुषसिंहयोः। चरित्वा विविधान् मार्गान् मण्डलस्तथानमेव त॥
en: Thus there ensued a fierce battle between those two foremost of warriors, who roved about (in the field of battle) in several ways and circles.

sa: ये नः प्राणाः शिरोये च ये नो योधा महारथाः॥ त एते धार्तराष्ट्रेषु विषक्ताः पुरुषर्षभाः।
en: are “They who are like our lives, they that are our heads, they that are our heads, they that are possessed of immense strength those foremost of men now all engaged with the Dhritarashtra hosts.

sa: एतच्छ्रुत्वा च दृष्ट्वा च भ्रातुर्घोरं महद्भयम्। वाहयाश्वान् हृषीकेश क्षिप्रमित्याह पाण्डवः॥
en: Hearing of the great and immense fear of his brother (Yudhishthira), as also witnessing it, the Pandava readily addressed him thus-'O Hrishikesha, urge the horses.'

sa: वर्जयन् ब्राह्मणं युद्धे शनैर्याहि यतोऽर्जुनः। अर्जुनं भीमसेनं वा समरे प्राप्य सारथे॥ क्षेममद्य भवेदेवमेषा मे नैष्ठिकी मतिः।
en: After abandoning the twice-born person in the battle, possessed slowly where Arjuna stays. After having come to the presence of either Arjuna or Bhima in the field, O charioteer, I will surely attain prosperity today. This is my certain belief.

sa: ततः प्रायान्महाराज सारथिस्त्वरयन् हयान्॥ यतो भीम महेष्वासो युयुधे तव सैनिकैः।
en: Thereupon, O powerful king, the charioteer, after having driven the horses, advanced to the place, where that powerful bowman, Bhimasena, was battling with your soldiers.

sa: मन्यमानो हतं कर्णं धर्मराजो युधिष्ठिरः। हर्षगद्गदया वाचा प्रीतः प्राह परंतपः॥
en: Thinking that Karna had been killed the virtuous king was delighted and he then addressed them thus, with his with his accents suppressed with joy.

sa: अथान्ये धनुषी चित्रे प्रगृह्य च महाशरान्। सात्यकिं छादयन्तौ तौ चेरतुर्लघु सुष्ठु च॥
en: Then having grasped two other beautiful bows and most effective shafts, they two, too, shrounded Satyaki (with the arrows) and roved about in the field with immense activity and expertness.

sa: कामं खलु न रोषो मे हैडिम्बे विद्यते त्वयि॥ किं तु रोषान्वितो जन्तुर्हन्यादात्मानमप्युता
en: O son of Hidimva, I am in no way angry with you in my mind. But when a creature is excited with rage, it may (then) kill its own self.

sa: पुनश्च शरवर्षेण च्छादयामास भारत। कर्णो वैकर्तनो युद्धे भीमसेनमरिंदमः॥
en: But once more, O Bharata, that subduer of foes viz., Vikartana's son Karna, covered Bhimasena with a shower of arrows.

sa: भीमसेनस्तु सव्रीडमुपेत्य द्रोणमाहवे। अश्वत्थामा हत इति शब्दमुच्चैश्चकार ह॥
en: Then Bhimasena approaching Drona with a little bashfulness began to exclaim to the top of his voice “Ashvatthaman is slain."

sa: पीड्यमानसतु कर्णेन युयुधानो महारथः। विव्याध बहुभिः कर्णं त्वरमाणः पुनः पुनः॥
en: Thereupon Karna taking Vrishasena the mighty car-warrior to be slain, was afflicted with grief on account of his son's death and began to afflict Satyaki.

sa: त एनं विविधैः शस्त्रैः शरधाराभिरेव च। अभ्यवर्षन् विमर्दन्तं प्रावृषीभाम्बुदा गिरिम्॥
en: Showering upon him various kinds of weapons and arrows they began to assail him like the clouds striking the mountain breast during the rainy season.

sa: ततः काको भृषं श्रान्तो हंसमभ्यागमत्तदा॥ तं तथा हीयमानं तु हंसो दृष्ट्वाब्रवीदिदम्। उजिहीर्षुर्निमज्जन्त स्मरन् सत्पुरुषव्रतम्॥
en: Thereupon greatly exhausted the crow came up to the swan. Thereupon beholding him about to sink and with a view to rescue him the swan, remembering the good offices of the pious, said to him-

sa: श्रुत्वा तु स्थनिर्घोषं गाण्डीवस्य च निःश्वनम्। सूतपुत्रोऽब्रवीद् राजन् दुर्योधनमिदं वचः॥
en: When that dreadful destruction of heroes was progressing, O king, the terrible twang of the Gandiva bow was heard, arising above the din of battle.

sa: एष सर्वां चमूं हत्वा मुख्यांश्चैव नरर्षभान्। पौरवांश्च महेष्वासो विक्षिपनुत्तमं धनुः॥
en: Having heard the sound of the Gandiva and the clatter of (Arjuna's) car, Oking Suta's son addressing Duryodhana said these wordsपार्थो विजयते तत्र गाण्डीवनिनदो महान्।

sa: ते समन्तान्महाबाहुं परिवार्य वृकोदरम्। दिशः शरैः समावृण्वशलभानामिव व्रजैः॥
en: Surrounding the mighty-armed Vrikodara on all sides, they began to cover the quarters with their arrows resembling flights of locusts.

sa: करोति पाण्डवो व्यक्तं कर्मोपयिकमात्मनः। एषा विदार्यते राजन् बहुधा भारती चमूः॥
en: The clatter of his chariot is also heard, like the rumble of roaring clouds. Evidently the son of Pandu is achieving feats worthy of himself.

sa: तथा त्विह व्रजत्येष परलोकाय माधवः। तथा कुरु महाराज सुनीत्या सुप्रयुक्तया॥
en: Let those mighty heroes be quick in shooting their arrows, so that this scion of Madhu's race may be dispatch to the next world. a

sa: आसीदाल्पवतो वेदस्तस्य राजन् महात्मनः॥ गरुडस्येव पततो जिघृक्षोः पन्नगोत्तमम्।
en: The motion of that high-souled one as he rushed on resembled that of Garuda, swooping down for catching a snake.

sa: श्रुत्वा तद् भगवान् देवो देवानिदमुवाच ह। ममापि सोऽपरानोति यो युष्माकामसौम्यकृत्य्॥
en: Having listened to all that, the lord god addressed all the celestials, saying this. That injurious fellow, who offends you, does surely offend me too.'

sa: प्रगृह्य महाशलान् दध्मुः पुरुषसत्तमाः। पूरयन्तो दिवं राजन् पृथिवीं च ससागराम्॥
en: Those foremost of men taking up their huge conchs blew them and with blasts they filled the welkin and the earth with her all oceans.

sa: पितामहस्तव तथा बाह्लीकः सह बाह्निकैः। निहतो भीमसेन महाबलपराक्रमः॥
en: So also your grand father Balhika, endued with great strength and prowess, was slain by Bhimasena with all the Balhikas,

sa: द्यूतं कृत्वा पुरा हृष्टो वञ्चयित्वा च पाण्डवान्॥ शकुनिः सौबलस्तात हते कर्णे किमब्रवीत्।
en: O son, when Karna was slain, what did Shakuni, the son of Subala, having at first played at dice with a cheerful heart and deceived the son of Pandu, say?

sa: रथामारुरुहे वीरो धनंजयशरार्दितः। प्रगृह्य च धनुः श्रेष्ठ पार्थ विव्याध सायकैः॥
en: Thus wounded by Dhananjaya with arrows the hero got on his chariot. And taking up his bow he began to strike Partha with innumerabie arrows.

sa: भीमोऽप्यतिबलं सैन्यं धार्तराष्ट्र व्यपोथयत् । अथ कर्णोऽब्रवीच्छल्यं पञ्चालान् प्रापयस्व माम्॥
en: The mighty Bhima also began to smite down the Dhritarasthra troops. Upon this Karna ordered (his driver) Shalya to make straight way for the Panchalas.

sa: श्चचार मार्गान नकुलश्चित्ररूपान्॥ अथास्य तूर्ण चरतो नरेन्द्र खड्न चित्रं नकुलस्य तस्य। महेषुभिर्व्यधमत् कर्णपुत्रो महाहवे चर्म सहस्रतारम्॥
en: After thwarting the hosts of arrowy of his foe, Nakula went on making mans beautiful evolutions in the air, but Karna's son, O monarch, in that fierce encounter, with his powerful shafts cut-off his shield studded with a thousand stars.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच इति श्रुत्वा महाराज धृतराष्ट्रोऽम्बिकासुतः। अब्रवीत् संजयं सूतं शोकसंविग्नमानसः॥
en: Vaishampayana said O great king, hearing this intelligence, Dhritarashtra, the son of Ambika, with a heart filled with great anxiety on account of sorrow, an

sa: हतेषु तेषु वीरेषु प्रदुद्राव बलं तव॥ पश्यतः सूतपुत्रस्य पाण्डवस्य भयादितम्।
en: After those ten brave warriors have fallen, your troops being afraid of the Pandavas began to give way even in the presence of Karna himself.

sa: कृत्वा तत् कर्म बीभत्सुरुग्रमुग्रपराक्रमः। विव्याध शकुनि भूयः पञ्चभिर्नतपर्वभिः॥
en: Then Vibhatsu on fierce energy having achieved that dreadful feat once more pierced Sakuni with five arrows of depressed knots.

sa: पुनः कर्णस्त्रिसप्तत्या भीमसेनपथेषुभिः। पुत्रं परीप्सन् विव्याध क्रूरं क्रूरैर्जिघांसया॥
en: With a view to save his son and kill the ruthless Bhima Karna struck the former with seventy-three dreadful arrows.

sa: केऽरक्षनं दक्षिणं चक्रं सूतपुत्रस्य युध्यतः। वामं चक्रं ररक्षुर्वा के वा वीरस्य पृष्ठतः॥
en: While the son of Suta was fighting, who were the persons guarding his right wheel and those who protected his left and again, who were they that guarded his back.

sa: संजय उवाच संसन्त इव मज्जानस्तावकानां भयानृप। तौ दृष्ट्वा समतिक्रान्तौ वासुदेवधनंजयौ॥
en: Sanjaya said Beholding, king, Vasudeva and Dhananjaya penetrate into their ranks, having already pierced through many divisions, the kings of yours army fled in fear.

sa: दैत्या ऊचुः वयं पुराणि त्रीण्येव समास्थाय महीमिमाम्। विचरिष्याम लोकेऽस्मिस्त्वत्प्रसाद पुरुस्कृताः॥
en: Asuras said 'In this world having kept your grace always in the front we will, living in three different cities, wonder over this entire earth.

sa: एष ते निहतो बन्धुस्त्वया दृष्टोऽस्य विक्रमः॥ पुनर्देष्टासि कर्णस्य निष्ठामेतां तथाऽऽत्मनः।
en: Here is your friend slain whose prowess you have witnessed yourself. You are destined to see the death of Karna and that of your ownself.

sa: यत्र ते बहवस्तात कौरवेया व्यवस्थिताः॥ सेनां दुरोदरं विद्धि शरानक्षान् विशाम्पते।
en: Now in this field where numerous Kurus have been assembled, know the troops to be the players and arrows the dice, O ruler of men.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच कथा यातेषु सैन्येषु तथा कृच्छ्रगत: स्वयम्॥ कचिद् दुर्योधनः सूत नाकार्षीत् पृष्ठतो रणम्।
en: Dhritarastra said When the Pandava host was thus advancing and when he was involved in great danger, I hope, O son of a charioteer, Duryodhana did not turn his back on the field of battle.

sa: स ताड्यमानो बहुभिर्भीमसेनो महाबलः। पञ्चभिः पञ्चभिः सर्वांस्तानविध्यच्छितैः शरैः॥
en: Then the highly puissant Bhimasena, wounded by those numerous Rakshasas, pierced each of them in return with five sharp arrows.

sa: जग्मुर्वैकर्तनं कर्णं राक्षसांश्चैव तान् रणे। अथ पूर्णायतोत्सृष्टैः शरैराशीविषोपमैः॥
en: Assailed Karna and the inferior Rakshasas. Then with shafts shot from full drawn bows and resembling snakes of virulent poison.
